adds.title: Mali New Penal Code - Transitional National Council
adds.summary: On 31 October 2024 Mali's Transitional National Council adopted a new Penal Code promulgated in December 2024 and published in Official Journal Special No.21 of 2024 defining homosexuality as sexual relations between persons of the same sex and punishing it with 2 to 5 years' imprisonment and a fine of 200,000 to 500,000 CFA francs, with no recognition of affirmed gender, exposing transgender visitors to prosecution based on sex assigned at birth and to arrest for perceived same-sex conduct.
